product_metadata.title: Rev-A-Shelf Heavy Duty Door Mount Kit-RVDM117KIT-Silver, Standard, Silver
features: Fits all RV series waste containers, HPRV/HRV hampers, and 5CW2 series cookware organizers
Kit includes: set of brackets (1 left, 1 right), 2 x ¼” and ½” bolts, 2 x ¼” and ½” washers, 4 x 10# x ½” truss head screws, 4 x nylock nuts.
Door face, waste bins, extension frames NOT included
Assembled Dimensions: 1-1/2” W x 2-1/8” D x 8” H
description: Rev-A-Shelf’s RVDM117KIT door mount kit allows cabinet door face to be mounted directly to waste container frames and other Rev-A-Shelf pull-outs for one step access. Fits all RV series waste containers, HPRV/HRV hampers, and 5CW2 series cookware organizers. Heavy duty design. Can be installed on almost any door style. Easily installed, six-way adjustable.

details.Included Components: Included: (2) door brackets, (2) frame brackets and hardware
